nom: Clinique Dramatically Different Moisturizing Lotion+ For Face

segments.oily: The one reviewer with oily skin reports it absorbs well without a greasy film, though she notes it does not control oil, so very oily skin may find it too dewy in summer.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry to very dry skin overwhelmingly report significant relief from flakiness and tightness with regular use; one reviewer finds it excellent in winter but too heavy for her skin in summer.
segments.combination: The reviewers with combination skin report it works well year-round without leaving their skin greasy or oily.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including some using it for decades without a single reaction, report it as gentle and non-irritating. A real minority, however, report severe reactions, including red, itchy, burning rashes that in one case required urgent care, which they attribute to dyes in the formula.
segments.mature: Many reviewers who have used the lotion for decades, now in their 40s to 80s, report their skin looking noticeably younger than their age and credit consistent long-term use.

concerns.aging: Many long-term users, some who have used the lotion for decades, report looking noticeably younger than their age and credit consistent use for it; one contrasts an aunt who has used it for years and has no wrinkles with a younger relative using a different moisturizer who does. This reads as a cumulative effect of consistent moisturizing rather than a specific anti-aging claim.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including many with dry or very dry skin, report significant, lasting hydration without heaviness or a greasy feel. A minority report the opposite: one felt it left a suffocating film on her skin along with burning, another found it did not hydrate at all, and one finds it too heavy specifically in summer.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report significant reactions: red, itchy, burning rashes serious enough in one case to require urgent care, and a rash in another, both citing dyes in the ingredient list. Most other reviewers, however, including some using it daily for decades, report no irritation at all.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers specifically credit the lotion with repairing or maintaining their skin barrier, including one who says it rescued her skin after a different moisturizer damaged her barrier, and another who broke out when she briefly switched to something else.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers note it does not cause breakouts, including one who broke out when she briefly used a different moisturizer instead; this is not a major focus of most reviews.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers report the lotion absorbs without a greasy or oily finish; one reviewer with oily skin notes, however, that it does not actively control oil, so very oily skin may find it too dewy in summer.

aspects.libelle: Small amount goes a long way
Layers well under makeup without pilling
Jumbo size sometimes arrives without its box
Screw-on lid less convenient than a flip-top

extraits.texte: skin has been covered in red, itchy, burning rashes after two uses. had to go to the walk in urgent care for relief, skin is still extremely dry and itchy

extraits.titre: Really nice lotion for oily skin
extraits.texte: As someone with oily skin, I was surprised by how well the Clinique "Yellow Lotion" worked for me. The texture looks a bit rich at first, but it absorbs quickly and doesn't leave a greasy film. It gives just the right amount of hydration without clogging pores, and it sits nicely under makeup. It doesn't control oil, so very oily skin might find it a bit too dewy in summer, but as a simple, reliable moisturizer, it's hard to go wrong with this one.

This is by far the best face moisturizer I have ever used!! I have extremely dry skin and this has helped me tremendously! I will buy this again and again! It last all day! Do yourself a favor and buy this!! You will not be disappointed!

I have used this product since I discovered Clinique when I was 22 years old. The 3-step regimen became part of my daily routine and 47 years later I still consider it the best skin care on the market. There is something about this moisturizer that has always complemented my skin care routine. I have added other items - including Moisture Surge products to my daily program- but this moisturizer is always the item I reach for first. If compliments mean anything - at 69 years old, I will take them - I've been told my skin tone and overall skin appearance is that of a woman in her early 40's. ❤️ Compliments are great and they are due to Clinique!
I use this moisturizer year round. I have combination skin and this is perfect for me. It doesn't leave my skin greasy or oily.

extraits.titre: Only moisturizer that works for my sensitive skin.
extraits.texte: The perfect lotion to repair skin barrier that doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. My teenage daughter bought this and her skin looked so beautiful that I snuck in her room and tried it and have never looked back!

extraits.titre: I love this product in the winter...not much the summer
extraits.texte: I really love this moisturizer for the winter! I get extremely dry skin and this helps so much! I used it everyday at night and my skin became less flaky with dry skin. For the summer, this moisturizer is a little too heavy for my skin. This is just my preference.
